description: This file appears to be a server-side PHP script that generates an HTML page for managing Ethernet LAN ports on a gateway device. It includes functions to retrieve device parameters, dynamic content generation based on device state, and JavaScript for interactive UI controls.

methods.name: getPort4XHSEnabled
methods.description: Determines if port 4 is configured for XHS based on device parameters.
methods.returns: Boolean indicating if port 4 XHS is enabled.

methods.name: NameMap
methods.description: Maps Ethernet port status to user-friendly label based on device configuration and partner ID.
methods.returns: A string representing the port status label.
